column4: artifact
column6: acceptance_criterion
column9: notes

column4: Time-resolved 3-D biomass stacks of the target consortium: at least one training and one INDEPENDENT held-out stack, each with voxel calibration and a declared segmentation basis
column6: select_pitch() returns a factor: the coarsest pitch preserving all six declared observables within tolerance on training AND held-out stacks
column9: NOT IDENTIFIABLE FROM A CELL VOLUME. V_physical = V_sites*a^3 fixes only the product, so a morphology dataset is necessary and not sufficient — a second constraint must be declared. Held-out means an independent sample, not another frame of the same file: that is what stopped the V. cholerae pilot.

column4: The five acceptance thresholds, filled in BEFORE the stacks are analysed
column6: minimum_minor_axis_voxels, maximum_volume_quantization_error, maximum_axis_ratio_error, maximum_memory_bytes and minimum_objects_per_species all set
column9: Declared in advance or the pitch is chosen by looking at the answer. select_pitch() refuses without complete tolerances, which is the same rule enforced twice.

column4: An entity_kind and status for every species in the consortium
column6: no species left unresolved; no literal_generation_claim_allowed = true
column9: A literal-cell claim returns MODEL_REVISION_REQUIRED and outranks every other verdict: compute_delta_H has no shape or connectivity term, V_target is one global scalar, and divide_cell! has no trigger. A CPM cell ID is a computational biomass parcel.

column4: The selected dynamic observable: biomass_autocorrelation_decay
column6: exactly one selected observable, and it is selectable: represented_by_model, measurable and semantically_compatible_with_parcel
column9: ALREADY DECLARED and the gate accepts it. It is listed because selecting it BINDS THE CAMPAIGN: the experimental quantity is the correlation length of the segmented biomass field OVER TIME, so the stacks must be time-resolved. Selecting before the spatial calibration was deliberate, to avoid a static campaign that would have to be repeated.

column4: Time-resolved 3-D stacks: the same field imaged at multiple timepoints, enough to fit a decay
column6: a declared timepoint count and interval, sufficient to fit the decay of the spatial correlation length
column9: NO MINIMUM TIMEPOINT COUNT EXISTS IN THE CODE OR THE LEDGER. Two is the arithmetic floor for a decay rate and is not a design. The campaign must DECLARE the count and interval and justify them; do not infer a number from this repository, because there is none to infer.

column4: An institutional biosafety approval id for every growth condition, obtained BEFORE culturing
column6: institutional_approval_id names a real approval (filler text refused), an issuing authority is named, approval_source_id resolves to a document_type = institutional_biosafety_approval row with a locator, approval_effective_date <= culturing_start_date < approval_expiration_date, the approval has not expired, approval_scope_hash matches the row's conditions, and is_target_system = true
column9: Biosafety follows STRAINS, not species: C. neoformans is BSL-2 where the others are BSL-1. A surrogate exercises the harness and can never clear the target gate. HARDENED: this was a presence check, and since the schema already refuses a blank it was very nearly a no-op -- any non-empty string cleared it, including the words 'd approved'. See calibration/biofilm_calibration/approval.py. The checks verify the fields a reviewer would ask for; they cannot verify the document is genuine, and no local check can.

column4: Paired wet mass and hydrated volume on the SAME coupon, with a stated surface-water removal protocol and a matched blank
column6: volume_basis = whole_biofilm_envelope (or a declared pore_volume_fraction), and every row names a blank_sample_id
column9: THE VOLUME MUST ENCLOSE WHAT THE BALANCE WEIGHED. A balance weighs cells plus matrix plus interstitial water; a cells_only mask encloses none of the last two and rho_wet comes out systematically HIGH. cells_only is refused outright.

column4: A matched blank coupon per bulk measurement: the substrate carried through the identical handling and drying with no biofilm
column6: every bulk_measurements row resolves to a blank_sample_id
column9: Blank subtraction is the DEFINITION of a biofilm mass. An unblanked sample attributes the substrate and its retained water to the biofilm.

column4: Dry mass on the same coupons, to a stated end point
column6: paired with the wet mass of the same sample_id
column9: Gives the dry biomass concentration and, with the wet mass, the water fraction that dominates the hydrated composition.

column4: Closed hydrated elemental composition: water plus dry organic (CHNS) plus ash plus salts plus metals, blended to mass fractions
column6: mass fractions sum to 1 within 1e-6 and evidence_basis is direct_measurement, manufacturer_datasheet, primary_literature or derived
column9: CLOSED is the requirement, not complete. Anything unmeasured has to be carried explicitly as a residual component with a declared composition, or the fractions cannot sum to 1 and the loader refuses the config.

column4: A paired_sample_group linking each imaged stack to the coupon whose mass was weighed
column6: no sample in either table has an empty paired_sample_group
column9: Enforced on BOTH sides. An unpaired density describes a different biofilm from the one the pitch was fitted to, and the join is the only thing that makes them one system.

column4: A replicate count per condition, sized from the pilot's own variance
column6: detectability() clears before required_replicates() is consulted
column9: ORDER MATTERS. A mass under the blank's noise is a SUBSTRATE problem, not a replicate problem, and no number of replicates fixes it. Size the campaign only after detectability passes.

column4: material_model_kind for every component
column6: hydrated_effective_medium only
column9: The mapper assigns ONE material class per occupied voxel. explicit_components would need sub-voxel homogenization, which does not exist.

column4: Density and closed composition of the bulk medium surrounding the biofilm
column6: closed to 1 and exportable evidence_basis
column9: The medium fills every unoccupied voxel and the lattice outer region, so it carries most of the domain's mass and most of the attenuation.

column4: Membrane density and closed composition
column6: closed to 1; a manufacturer datasheet is exportable evidence
column9: Fixed-membrane declaration: the membrane is held constant for this stage, so its composition is a fixed input and not a dose-responsive one.

column4: As-built radial thickness of the membrane annulus
column6: positive, and cylinder_radius_cm + membrane_thickness_cm must stay inside the tallied lattice cube
column9: A membrane reaching outside the lattice cube is partly untallied and its mass accounting is silently incomplete. structural_problems() refuses it.

column4: As-built metrology of the biological domain
column6: check_lattice_congruence passes: radius <= side/2 and length <= side, for side = lattice_n * pitch
column9: Reference C could never be a full-length MABR in the CPM: L = 2R is structural (R = N/2 recomputed at 7 sites, no length field), so an extreme aspect ratio is unrepresentable at any feasible voxel count.

column4: The CPM lattice size implied by the domain extent and the selected pitch
column6: lattice_n * pitch >= the domain, and mesh_coarsening_factor divides lattice_n so the meshes nest
column9: Has no independent measurement: it is domain extent divided by pitch, and both come from other rows.

column4: As-built source placement relative to the biological domain origin
column6: off every lattice plane and inside the biological domain (check_source_placement)
column9: The derived centre n*pitch/2 lands on a lattice plane for every even lattice size, and on the z axis independently of it. An explicit position is the only way through.

column4: Which idealization represents the real source
column6: one of line_z_axis or point_origin, with the idealization written down
column9: A REAL SEALED CAPSULE CANNOT BE REPRESENTED. Reference A1 is declared and unsupported: there is no active-core/capsule CSG, so no encapsulation and no self-attenuation. Using a point or line for a capsule is a declared modelling limitation, not a measurement, and must be recorded as one.

column4: A source assay certificate with an activity and a reference date
column6: S = A(t) * sum_j Y_j with A(t) = A0 * 2^(-(t-t0)/T_half); the PMF stays separate
column9: Transport needs NONE of this: heating is per source particle and transport_state_hash excludes photons_per_second. Only Gy/s needs it.

column4: Evaluated decay data for the source nuclide
column6: probabilities are a normalized PMF summing to 1; the loader does not normalize
column9: Keep S = A*sum_j Y_j separate from p_j = Y_j/sum_k Y_k. Conflating them silently mis-normalizes any nuclide emitting more than one photon per decay.

column4: The boundary treatment and the lattice origin, with justification
column6: boundaries in {vacuum, reflective}; the choice recorded
column9: Reflective represents infinite repetition and changes the problem. It must never be selected to improve tally statistics.

column4: The biofilm-specific resolution and history study — a SEPARATE threshold after the pitch exists
column6: a decision document naming the selected mesh, factor and history count with its ceiling
column9: A0's sweep decided the PHANTOM's numbers and its rows carry sensitivity_domain = transport_numerical, so it cannot appear to have ranked biology. The biofilm study must also report cell-, lineage- and generation-dose rank stability, which A0 has no labels to measure.

column4: Metal loading with an active_fraction per row
column6: no row has a null active_fraction
column9: BLOCKED BY A UNITS ERROR UPSTREAM, not by missing data. compute_radial_biomass returns site occupancy and its unweighted mean is assigned to X_total/X_red, which is neither a biomass fraction nor an active-reducer fraction. Taxonomic abundance is not functional activity. Measuring this does not unblock it.

column4: The occupancy mapping from the continuous biomass field to a binary lattice, with its parameter
column6: mapping is threshold (with threshold_tau) or mass_preserving (with a seed)
column9: THE OCCUPANCY MAP IS PART OF THE CALIBRATION, not a preprocessing detail. threshold preserves connectivity but does not conserve biovolume; mass_preserving conserves biovolume in expectation but varies by seed. Neither is correct in general, so apply_occupancy() refuses while it is unset, and an unseeded mass_preserving run cannot be reproduced.

column4: What the CPM lattice is claimed to represent
column6: domain.semantics is microvolume, representative_segment or full_apparatus — never unresolved
column9: THE CPM FORCES L = 2R. R = N/2 is recomputed at seven sites and there is no length field, so an apparatus whose real aspect ratio is not 2 cannot be claimed as full_apparatus AT ANY PITCH. That is a topology fact, not a resolution one, and it is why Reference C can never be a full-length MABR here.

column4: The six per-observable tolerances select_pitch judges a candidate pitch by
column6: maximum error set for biovolume_fraction, porosity, interface_area, correlation_length, thickness and component_size
column9: Distinct from the five [representation] thresholds: those decide whether a SHAPE is representable at a pitch, these decide whether a coarsened FIELD still preserves the declared observables. select_pitch() refuses if any one is unset.

column4: The material acceptance thresholds, declared before the assays are read
column6: maximum_density_relative_uncertainty, maximum_composition_closure_error, minimum_replicates and maximum_unaccounted_dry_mass_fraction all set
column9: allow_oxygen_by_difference is already true, but a fraction obtained that way MUST be recorded as analysis_method = by_difference in elemental_analysis.csv — otherwise a closure that was assumed reads as a closure that was measured.

column4: An axial-face compatibility check on the Reference D snapshots used for transport
column6: biomass occupancy near z_lo and z_hi statistically compatible; no large aggregate truncated at either face; axial profiles agree within a declared tolerance
column9: A REFLECTIVE AXIAL FACE IMPOSES MIRROR SYMMETRY, which is consistent with a longer uniform reactor only if the material near both faces supports that continuation. An arbitrary CPM snapshot may vary strongly along z and the serial CPM has finite axial boundaries, not periodic topology. The declaration is stamped axial_boundary_validation_required; the check needs a real snapshot, so it is recorded now and implemented when one exists. Fallback if it fails: axial vacuum scored over a central region distant from the ends.
